description: World- Unconventional Hydrocarbon Resources: Shale Basins is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Resource assessments", published or maintained by West Virginia Geographic Information Systems Technology Center (WV GIS TC) United States Department of Energy (DOE) National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL) (World Resources Institute). The West Virginia Geographic Information Systems Technical Center (WVGISTC) and West Virginia University (WVU) collaborated with the World Resources Institute (WRI) to compile digital GIS geometry and attribute data of major natural basins that are targets of gas and liquid hydrocarbon unconventional resources worldwide. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Resource assessments. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
